$comment: Codex device approvals (the opt-in PermissionRequest hold). Rules: shared/src/codex-approval-hold.ts (Swift: generated CodexApprovalHoldRules). Replayed by shared/src/__tests__/codex-approval-hold.test.ts, bridge/src/__tests__/codex-approval-hold.test.ts, hooks/src/__tests__/codex-install.test.ts and apple/AgentDeckTests/CodexApprovalHoldTests.swift. 'posixHoldCommand' is the exact command both installers emit (Codex hashes it for trust, so a one-byte drift re-prompts every user); 'posixPermissionRequestGroup' is AgentDeck's PermissionRequest group as both write it into config.toml, the hold as its second handler. 'decisions' is the hook stdout per device decision (null = print nothing, Codex shows its own prompt). 'budgets' maps the hold header (the command's wait in seconds) and the daemon's configured hold to the hold actually used (null = do not hold). 'eligibility' is when a daemon holds at all. 'presses' maps an option press on a held approval to its decision, as a deck's Allow / Deny keys send it (null = not an answer; nothing is resolved). 'releasingEvents' end the turn a hold waits in and release it early; 'nonReleasingEvents' must not (a parallel call's tool hooks and notification leave the open hold alone). 'capturedPermissionRequest' is a verbatim codex-cli 0.160.1 PermissionRequest stdin payload (2026-10-18, home path scrubbed); it carries no tool_use_id.
posixHoldCommand:
exec sh -c 'PORT="${AGENTDECK_PORT:-}"
case "$PORT" in '"'"''"'"'|*[!0-9]*) PORT="" ;; *) [ "$PORT" -ge 1 ] 2>/dev/null && [ "$PORT" -le 65535 ] 2>/dev/null || PORT="" ;; esac
if [ -z "$PORT" ]; then
  for F in "$HOME/.agentdeck/daemon.json" "$HOME/Library/Containers/bound.serendipity.agent.deck/Data/Library/Application Support/AgentDeck/daemon.json" "$HOME/Library/Group Containers/group.bound.serendipity.agent.deck/daemon.json"; do
    [ -f "$F" ] || continue
    P=$(python3 -c "import json,sys,signal;signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,lambda *_:sys.exit(0));signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,0.2);d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));p=d.get('"'"'httpPort'"'"') or d.get('"'"'port'"'"');print(p if type(p) is int and 1 <= p <= 65535 else '"'"''"'"')" "$F" 2>/dev/null)
    [ -n "$P" ] && curl -sf --connect-timeout 0.2 --max-time 0.3 "http://127.0.0.1:$P/health" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { PORT="$P"; break; }
  done
fi
PORT="${PORT:-9120}"
R=$(curl -sf --connect-timeout 0.2 --max-time 55 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/hooks/codex_permission_request" -H '"'"'Content-Type: application/json'"'"' -H "X-AgentDeck-Pid: $PPID" -H "X-AgentDeck-Hold: 55" -d @- 2>/dev/null) || R=""
case "$R" in *'"'"'"hookSpecificOutput"'"'"'*) printf '"'"'%s'"'"' "$R" ;; esac'

case "$PORT" in '"'"''"'"'|*[!0-9]*) PORT="" ;; *) [ "$PORT" -ge 1 ] 2>/dev/null && [ "$PORT" -le 65535 ] 2>/dev/null || PORT="" ;; esac
if [ -z "$PORT" ]; then
  for F in "$HOME/.agentdeck/daemon.json" "$HOME/Library/Containers/bound.serendipity.agent.deck/Data/Library/Application Support/AgentDeck/daemon.json" "$HOME/Library/Group Containers/group.bound.serendipity.agent.deck/daemon.json"; do
    [ -f "$F" ] || continue
    P=$(python3 -c "import json,sys,signal;signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,lambda *_:sys.exit(0));signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,0.2);d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1]));p=d.get('"'"'httpPort'"'"') or d.get('"'"'port'"'"');print(p if type(p) is int and 1 <= p <= 65535 else '"'"''"'"')" "$F" 2>/dev/null)
    [ -n "$P" ] && curl -sf --connect-timeout 0.2 --max-time 0.3 "http://127.0.0.1:$P/health" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { PORT="$P"; break; }
  done
fi
PORT="${PORT:-9120}"
curl -sf --connect-timeout 0.2 --max-time 0.8 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/hooks/codex_permission_request" -H '"'"'Content-Type: application/json'"'"' -H "X-AgentDeck-Pid: $PPID" -d @- >/dev/null 2>&1 || true'"
timeout = 5
[[hooks.PermissionRequest.hooks]]
type = "command"
command = "exec sh -c 'PORT="${AGENTDECK_PORT:-}"
case "$PORT" in '"'"''"'"'|*[!0-9]*) PORT="" ;; *) [ "$PORT" -ge 1 ] 2>/dev/null && [ "$PORT" -le 65535 ] 2>/dev/null || PORT="" ;; esac
if [ -z "$PORT" ]; then
  for F in "$HOME/.agentdeck/daemon.json" "$HOME/Library/Containers/bound.serendipity.agent.deck/Data/Library/Application Support/AgentDeck/daemon.json" "$HOME/Library/Group Containers/group.bound.serendipity.agent.deck/daemon.json"; do

    [ -n "$P" ] && curl -sf --connect-timeout 0.2 --max-time 0.3 "http://127.0.0.1:$P/health" >/dev/null 2>&1 && { PORT="$P"; break; }
  done
fi
PORT="${PORT:-9120}"
R=$(curl -sf --connect-timeout 0.2 --max-time 55 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:$PORT/hooks/codex_permission_request" -H '"'"'Content-Type: application/json'"'"' -H "X-AgentDeck-Pid: $PPID" -H "X-AgentDeck-Hold: 55" -d @- 2>/dev/null) || R=""
case "$R" in *'"'"'"hookSpecificOutput"'"'"'*) printf '"'"'%s'"'"' "$R" ;; esac'"

decision.message: Denied from the user's AgentDeck controller.

budgets.name: a shorter command budget caps the hold below it
a budget too short to be worth a stall does not hold
absurdly long budget is not a number we trust

eligibility.name: a hold already open on the session

presses.name: any other index is not an answer
a negative index is not an answer
an index sent as a string is not an answer
select_option without an index is not an answer
respond yes allows, whatever its case and padding
an unknown word is not an answer
an empty word is not an answer
respond without a value is not an answer
a stop is not an answer

reviewerRecords.name: new legacy turn must not inherit automatic review
new unknown settings must not inherit old review
